title: Wise Family Farm sets 12 Country Christmas nights in its 100th year
excerpt: The Shady Grove farm opens Dec. 4. Its calendar includes seven nights leading up to Christmas, with children 5 and younger admitted free.

paragraphs.text: A century after the Wise family settled on 80 acres in Shady Grove, the farm is opening its Christmas light trail for 12 evenings in December. The first is Friday, Dec. 4, from 5 to 9 p.m. at 291 Shady Grove Road in Pontotoc. The farm’s 2026 calendar marks each open night, including Christmas Eve and the Saturday after Christmas.

For the first two weekends, the gates open Friday and Saturday, Dec. 4–5 and Dec. 11–12. The longest run is seven evenings in a row, Friday, Dec. 18, through Thursday, Dec. 24. The calendar shows the farm closed on Christmas Day. Saturday, Dec. 26, is the last evening listed.

The farm lists admission at $9.99, and its 2026 ticket office displays $11.35 online, including $1.36 in fees. One ticket covers any single open evening and includes a s’mores kit. Children age 5 and younger get in free. Visitors can walk the lighted maze and Nativity trail, see the barnyard animals or stop at a campfire.

Monroe and Carrie Belle Dowdy Wise settled about five miles east of Ecru in 1926. They raised six children on the farm, which supplied the family with vegetables, meat and dairy products. The third generation now runs the property. The farm lists 662-538-8990 for visitors to call or text with questions.
